_note: Gate A result for the 2026-10-03 sample run. Started from fixtures/boards.proposed.json (automatic slug guesses). Evidence for each entry was gathered by the AI assistant (careers-page HTML, in-app browser, and cross-checking job IDs/titles against the board API); Airbyte, Anomali, BetterUp and Datadog were also checked by hand by AdityaHasija37. Every confirmed/rejected decision below was made by AdityaHasija37 after reading that evidence.

gate_a_rule.value: A board is confirmed if the company's own careers page links to or embeds it (direct), OR the job IDs / titles listed on the careers page match the board's postings (indirect).
gate_a_rule.history: Original rule (2026-10-03): direct link only. Widened the same day by AdityaHasija37 after 4 of 10 companies had only indirect evidence.

boards.how: no link visible on careers.datadoghq.com; the board's postings link back to careers.datadoghq.com/detail/<gh_jid>. First hand check said 'no'; changed to yes on this evidence.
discord.com/careers lists discord.com/jobs/<id>; 3 of 4 sampled IDs are on the Greenhouse board
payjoy.com/careers lists jobs with no visible host; 4 of 4 sampled title+location pairs are on the Lever board
sendbird.com redirects to delight.ai (rebrand); delight.ai/job/<id> matches 5 of 5 IDs on the Greenhouse board
